tasks.title: Create src/lib/seasons.ts module
tasks.description: Create a new file at src/lib/seasons.ts that owns the entire season calendar. Export: (1) `type Season` — string-literal union 'winter' | 'spring' | 'summer' | 'fall'; (2) `const SEASONS` — readonly tuple of all four seasons in calendar order ['winter','spring','summer','fall']; (3) `seasonForMonthIndex(monthIndex: number): Season` — used by runtime code working from Date objects; (4) `seasonForMonthName(name: string): Season | undefined` — case-insensitive lookup for build scripts parsing CSV month strings; returns undefined for unrecognised input; (5) `getCurrentSeason(referenceDate?: Date): Season` — convenience wrapper over seasonForMonthIndex defaulting to new Date(); (6) `getNextSeason(season: Season): Season` — calendar rollover winter→spring→summer→fall→winter. Use ONE internal data structure (object mapping month indices 0–11 to seasons). Implement seasonForMonthName by deriving a lowercase month-name → index map from the same data — no separate string-keyed table to drift. Preserve the current calendar mapping EXACTLY: December→winter, March–May→spring, June–August→summer, September–November→fall, January–February→winter. See PRD §Implementation Decisions / New module.
acceptance: const SEASONS — readonly tuple of all four seasons in calendar order.
seasonForMonthIndex(monthIndex: number): Season — used by runtime code working from Date objects.
seasonForMonthName(name: string): Season | undefined — case-insensitive; returns undefined for unrecognised input.
getCurrentSeason(referenceDate?: Date): Season — convenience wrapper over seasonForMonthIndex defaulting to new Date().
getNextSeason(season: Season): Season — calendar rollover helper.

Internal structure: A single object mapping month indices 0–11 to seasons; seasonForMonthName is implemented in terms of the same data plus a name-to-index lookup. There is no separate string-keyed table to drift.
The current calendar mapping (December → winter, March–May → spring, June–August → summer, September–November → fall, January–February → winter) is preserved exactly.
getNextSeason order: winter → spring → summer → fall → winter.
tasks.notes: Single source of truth is MONTH_INDEX_TO_SEASON. seasonForMonthName derives lowercase-name → index Map from a static MONTH_NAMES array, then routes through the same index map. seasonForMonthName trims input before lowercasing. getNextSeason uses SEASONS.indexOf + modulo so calendar order is owned solely by the SEASONS tuple.
